rules: P2 DECISION-AUTHORITY.md §3 A1-A9 with the §5 v0.2 changes C1-C5

decisions.statement: The fee printed by `fee <appointment>` is the visit fee of the appointment's clinician as listed in docs/visit-fees.md (DEC-C09), obtained through the single existing rule Rules.visitFee; the rule's doc comment is updated to name DEC-C09 as the decision it implements. No new fee rule is written in Commands or Cli.
reasons: A2 'docs/visit-fees.md' does not resolve to a requirement, decision record or approval

decisions.statement: Add Commands.fee : string -> State -> Result<State * string, ClinicError>. It looks up the appointment (UnknownAppointment id if absent, printed as `error: unknown appointment <id>` by the existing describeError), returns the state unchanged, and outputs `<id> visit fee <fee>` with the fee formatted with two decimals in the invariant culture ("0.00"), e.g. `a1 visit fee 60.00`. Cli.dispatch gains the case ["fee"; id]; a malformed `fee` line gets the existing `usage:` error via usageOf.

Insert `fee <appointment>` into Cli.usage directly after `cancel <appointment>`, so `help` lists it there; also add the same line after `cancel <appointment>` in the README Commands list so the documented command list stays complete.

UNRESOLVED QUESTION for Finance: docs/visit-fees.md lists a fee only for k1, and no source says what the fee is for an appointment whose clinician is not listed (e.g. k2, who is in the standard seed). The existing Rules.visitFee returns 0m for any unlisted clinician, but neither DEC-C09 nor docs/visit-fees.md supports a 0.00 fee, and nothing supports refusing either. The agent does not decide this: it will not add a new fallback, exception or error for unlisted clinicians, will not treat the existing 0m fallback as authorized policy, and will not add tests that assert any output for an unlisted clinician. Whatever Rules.visitFee currently returns is left unchanged pending a Finance decision.
reasons: A2 'docs/visit-fees.md' does not resolve to a requirement, decision record or approval

decisions.statement: A cancelled appointment is removed from state by the existing `cancel`, so `fee` on it prints `error: unknown appointment <id>`, the same as any unknown appointment. No special handling of cancelled appointments is added.

Add unit tests in tests/Clinic.Tests for the supported behaviour not covered by the acceptance tests: `fee` leaves state unchanged (e.g. schedule output identical before and after), a malformed `fee` line prints `error: usage: fee <appointment>`, and help still lists every command. No test asserts a fee for an unlisted clinician (see DEC-W-4).
